Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the PO stub. We can accept a consolidated PO for the renewal + add-on — thats typically simplest. Please send the signed PO to billing@redwood.com; Ill loop in our finance and CS teams to make sure the routing and any entity split are handled correctly.

Quick answers:
- Redwood EIN (US billing entity): 13-4567890
- If you need to split the invoice across entities, well need (a) payee name, (b) billing address, (c) EIN or tax id per entity, and (d) PO number per entity. We can create two linked invoices against the same deal id if thats preferred.

Monica — can you confirm the capacity proration for a mid-quarter add-on and whether a single invoice is ok for your team?

Marissa — can you confirm whether we need a W-9 from BridgeWave to finalize billing?

Thanks,

Hi all —

Confirmed on the capacity side: adding 60 GPU-hours to the Dedicated pool will be billed pro-rata from the effective date of the add-on. If BridgeWave wants the add-on to align with the existing renewal term (starting 2028-07-01), we can backdate proration to the term start instead of the execution date — whichever you prefer.

Operationally, a single consolidated invoice is fine as long as finance receives clear entity-level allocation when required. Well record the usage against the same subscription ID (deal DW-2028-1432) and tag splits in our ledger.

Sophie — if you foresee a split, provide the two payee blocks and well mirror them in the invoice template.

Best,

Thanks for sending the PO. A couple of notes from Finance:
1) Please attach a completed W-9 (for the US legal entity) or W-8 (if the payee is a non-US entity). We cannot process the PO without that.
2) For the consolidated invoice, list the primary payee as BridgeWave Systems Inc (EIN: 13-4567890). If you need a split, include "allocation%" per payee in the PO text and include each payees EIN/address.
3) Were able to accept Net45 terms for this renewal if your AP team confirms in writing. Otherwise standard Net30 applies.

Ill attach a short checklist to speed processing.
